description: Backlog and running state for the 15-iteration SEO loop. Each iteration fixes exactly one SEO element end to end (change + test + commit). Anything found that is too large for a single iteration is written here as a user story and picked up on a later pass. Iterations already spent are recorded in `loop.completed` so a fresh session can resume without re-auditing.

completed.title: Stop dating every static sitemap URL with the request date
completed.commit: see git log on this branch

userStories.title: Stop dating every static sitemap URL with the request date
userStories.description: As a search engine, I want <lastmod> to mean something, so that the dates on blog posts and guides are worth acting on.
acceptanceCriteria: renderSitemap emits <lastmod> only for entries that carry one
The 29 static marketing routes carry no <lastmod>
Blog posts and pSEO guides keep the real timestamp from their row
isoDate returns undefined instead of falling back to today
The Cloudflare Pages fallback sitemap carries no <lastmod> either
Unit tests cover the rendering, not just the source text
userStories.notes: Pure rendering moved to supabase/functions/generate-sitemap/render.ts so vitest can import it (index.ts imports the Supabase client from esm.sh and reads Deno.env, so it can only ever be asserted as text). Covered by src/lib/sitemap-render.test.ts, 9 tests. functions/sitemap.xml.ts lost all 29 `<lastmod>${today}</lastmod>` lines and the now-unused `today`. STATIC_ENTRIES stayed in index.ts because five other tests read that file as text for the route list.

userStories.title: /authors is submitted to Google and then declines to be indexed
userStories.description: As a site owner, I want the sitemap to stop advertising a URL that serves noindex, so that Search Console stops reporting 'Submitted URL marked noindex' and the E-E-A-T page either counts or is withdrawn.
acceptanceCriteria: Decide the resolution: populate public.blog_authors with real people, or withdraw /authors from the sitemap until it has rows
If withdrawn: the sitemap entry becomes conditional on blog_authors returning at least one row, so the page re-enters automatically once authors exist
The Cloudflare Pages fallback sitemap agrees with whatever the edge function does
src/lib/comparison-discovery.test.ts's carve-out comment for /authors is updated or removed to match
No fabricated author rows: the page's own header comment explains why placeholder clinicians were removed
userStories.notes: Flagged in supabase/functions/generate-sitemap/index.ts's own STATIC_ENTRIES comment: 'Populate the table, or drop this line, rather than leaving it in that state indefinitely.' The page is routed, prerendered, footer-linked and sitemapped, and src/pages/Authors.tsx sets noindex whenever blog_authors is empty. Needs a product call on whether real authors are coming, which is why it is not a same-iteration fix.

userStories.title: scripts/generate-sitemap.js is TypeScript in a .js file and cannot run
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want one sitemap generator, so that nobody reaches for the broken second one.
acceptanceCriteria: `node scripts/generate-sitemap.js` either runs or the file is gone
If kept, it agrees with supabase/functions/generate-sitemap on routes, retired slugs and the tier ceiling
Nothing in package.json or CI references a generator that does not exist
userStories.notes: The file declares `interface SitemapUrl` and typed parameters inside a .js module, so node throws a SyntaxError on the first interface. It is referenced by nothing, and the edge function has superseded it (it also handles retired slugs and the pSEO tier gate, which this one does not). Most likely resolution is deletion.

userStories.title: Edge-function tests never run
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the SEO logic that lives in supabase/functions to be covered by the suite, so that a change there is not shipped on inspection alone.
acceptanceCriteria: vitest picks up supabase/functions/**/*.test.ts (its include is currently 'src/**/*.{test,spec}.{ts,tsx}' only)
The existing tests under supabase/functions/_shared pass, or are fixed/removed with the reason recorded
Coverage thresholds still hold with the new files in scope
userStories.notes: supabase/functions/_shared carries ai-retention.test.ts, catalogPromotion.test.ts, image-gen.test.ts, meal-plan-templates.test.ts, parse-recipe-access.test.ts and more, none of which the runner has ever executed. Widening the glob will surface an unknown number of failures at once, so it needs its own iteration.

userStories.title: Reconsider changefreq and priority in the sitemap
userStories.description: As a search engine, I want a sitemap that carries only fields I use, so that the file is smaller and says nothing misleading.
acceptanceCriteria: Establish whether Bing and the AI crawlers named in robots.txt read either field before removing them
If removed, the fallback sitemap and the tests that count fields follow
userStories.notes: Google has stated it ignores both. Lower value than SEO-002/003/004 and needs the Bing question answered first, so it sits at the bottom until the loop runs out of higher-value work.
